note: Sealed Rating: factual position data for each sealed product against products of the same type. Not advice. Factor values are 0 to 1, the share of same-type products below this one.

rules.topCard: Highest-priced single in the set on the same day, TCGplayer market. Sets with fewer than 10 priced singles are left out.
rules.stage: Official rotation dates (rotation-status.json) and era release dates. Tins and collections are flagged because they can be made after a set's main print run.

waiting.label: Pack destruction range
waiting.why: Needs dated PSA population counts entered each month plus cleared pull-rate inputs. Ranges for a few sets are in the research doc, not on the site.

waiting.label: Listings trend
waiting.why: Needs 7 nights of eBay listings counts. 2 on file.

waiting.label: Set popularity
waiting.why: No dated, cleared source for how popular a set is yet.

waiting.label: Expected pack value
waiting.why: Needs per-set pull rates we can cite. Community rates vary by set and print run.

method: Doc: Catch'em Sealed Rating, research and design (Google Drive).
